title: After a Use of Force
summary: What to do once the scene is safe after any reportable use of force.

steps.text: Render first aid and request EMS for anyone injured or complaining of injury
Intervene and report if you saw another officer use excessive force
steps.detail: Duty to intervene under the AG Use of Force Policy

steps.text: Preserve body-worn camera and in-car video; tag the recordings
Photograph injuries to the subject and officers
Collect and preserve any weapons or physical evidence
Complete the use of force report in the state reporting system within your agency's deadline
Write a detailed narrative: the threat, resistance, de-escalation tried, force used and why, and when force stopped
Follow your agency's policy for any discharge of a weapon, serious injury or death (prosecutor notification)

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
